step1_analysis.circuit_type: Pseudo-Differential Two-Stage Amplifier / Variable Gain Amplifier (VGA)
step1_analysis.description: A pseudo-differential two-stage amplifier commonly used in baseband filters or VGAs for direct-conversion receivers. The first stage is a PMOS common-source amplifier with tunable triode-region PMOS source degeneration (for linearity and gain control), followed by an NMOS common-source second stage.

paper_reference.title: A Direct-Conversion CMOS Transceiver for the 802.11a/b/g WLAN Standard Utilizing a Cartesian Feedback Transmitter

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly reported for this sub-block

sky130_expected.calculation: First stage effective transconductance Gm1 = gm2 / (1 + gm2*Rs). With VBP=0.99V, XM9 is in triode acting as Rs ~ 6.9 kOhm. Gm1 ~ 70 uS. Rout1 ~ 515 kOhm. Av1 ~ 36 V/V. Second stage Av2 = gm4 * Rout2 ~ 455 uS * 131 kOhm ~ 60 V/V. Total Av = 36 * 60 = 2160 V/V = 66.6 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain depends heavily on the exact output resistance (lambda) of the transistors in SKY130, which varies with the exact DC bias point.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dominant pole is at the intermediate nodes (N3/N4) due to the Miller capacitance of the second stage. C_N4 ~ 150 fF. fp = 1 / (2 * pi * Rout1 * C_N4) = 1 / (2 * pi * 515k * 150f) ~ 2 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Bandwidth is limited by the high impedance of the first stage output and the Miller capacitance of the second stage. It can be higher if the first stage gain drops.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption from VDD.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on the provided bias voltages (VBN=0.54V, VBP=0.99V) and SKY130 typical parameters.

max_output_swing.description: Maximum peak-to-peak differential output voltage swing.

sky130_expected.calculation: Output can swing from Vdsat_NMOS (~0.2V) to VDD - Vdsat_PMOS (~1.4V). Single-ended swing ~ 1.2V. Differential swing ~ 2.4V peak-to-peak.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the saturation voltages of the output stage transistors XM4/XM5 and XM6/XM7.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC differential gain, -3dB bandwidth, and transient output swing of the pseudo-differential amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Pseudo-Differential Amplifier
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

XM1 N4 VBN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N4 VINN N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N3 VINP N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VOUTN N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 VOUTP N3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 VOUTP VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 VOUTN VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N3 VBN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N2 VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N1 VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVBN VBN 0 0.54
VVBP VBP 0 0.99
* Differential AC inputs (1V and -1V for 2V diff), 10mV peak for transient
VVINP VINP 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.01 1MEG 0 0)
VVINN VINN 0 DC 0.9 AC -1 SIN(0.9 -0.01 1MEG 0 0)

* VCVS to extract differential output
E_diff VOUT_DIFF 0 VOUTP VOUTN 1

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point & Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * 2. AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
  ac dec 100 1 1G
  * Subtract 6.02 dB because differential input is 2V (AC 1 - AC -1)
  let gain_db = vdb(VOUT_DIFF) - 6.02
  meas ac low_freq_gain find gain_db at=1k
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db='low_freq_gain - 3' fall=1

  * 3. Transient Analysis for Output Swing
  tran 1n 5u
  meas tran vout_diff_max max v(VOUT_DIFF)
  meas tran vout_diff_min min v(VOUT_DIFF)
  let max_output_swing = vout_diff_max - vout_diff_min
  print max_output_swing
  
  quit
.endc
.end
